# =========================================================
# CREATE EMPLOYEE FROM VISA AND PRO
# =========================================================

source_name = frappe.form_dict.get("name")

if not source_name:
    frappe.throw("Visa and PRO record name is required.")


# Fetch source record
source = frappe.get_doc("Visa and PRO", source_name)

source.check_permission("write")


# Validate stage
if source.current_stage != "Onboarded":
    frappe.throw(
        "You can create an Employee only when Current Stage is Onboarded."
    )


# Prevent duplicate creation
if source.custom_created_employee:

    frappe.response["message"] = {
        "employee": source.custom_created_employee,
        "message": "Employee already exists."
    }

else:

    # Validate mandatory fields
    if not source.first_name:
        frappe.throw("First Name is mandatory.")

    if not source.employee_type:
        frappe.throw("Employee Type is mandatory.")

    if source.employee_type == "Vendor" and not source.vendor_supplier:
        frappe.throw("Please select Vendor (Supplier).")


    # Create Employee document
    employee = frappe.new_doc("Employee")

    employee.first_name = source.first_name
    employee.middle_name = source.middle_name
    employee.last_name = source.last_name

    employee.gender = source.gender

    employee.date_of_birth = source.date_of_birth
    employee.date_of_joining = source.date_of_joining

    employee.custom_employee_type = source.employee_type

    employee.civil_id = source.civil_id

    employee.designation = source.designation
    employee.grade = source.grade

    # =====================================================
    # ADDRESS INFORMATION - NEW MAPPINGS
    # =====================================================

    employee.current_address = source.cust_visa_current_address

    employee.current_accommodation_type = source.cust_visa_current_address_is

    employee.permanent_address = source.cust_visa_permanent_address

    employee.permanent_accommodation_type = source.cust_visa_permanent_address_is

    # =====================================================

    employee.status = "Active"

    # Set Visa and PRO source record in Employee
    employee.custom_onboard_record_ = source.name


    # Save Employee
    employee.insert()


    # Store Employee reference in Visa and PRO
    source.db_set(
        "custom_created_employee",
        employee.name
    )


    # Return response
    frappe.response["message"] = {
        "employee": employee.name,
        "message": "Employee created successfully."
    }

# ========================================================= # VISA AND PRO # DYNAMIC CONDITIONAL MANDATORY VALIDATION # FRAPPE / ERPNEXT V16 # ========================================================= # ========================================================= # 1. STAGE TO SECTION BREAK MAPPING # ========================================================= stage_sections = { "Offer & Document Collection": "section_break_rjmw", "Certificate Attestation": "section_break_xpxp", "Labour Clearance Applied (MOL)": "section_break_1l0k", "Labour Clearance Approved": "section_break_a5tt", "GAMCA Medical & PCC": "gamca_medical_and_pcc_section", "Employment Visa Applied (ROP)": "employment_visa_applied_rop_section", "Employment Visa Issued": "employment_visa_issued_section", "Emigration & Flight Booked": "section_break_co5d", "Arrived in Oman (Medical & Biometrics)": "arrived_in_oman_medical_and_biometrics_section", "Resident Card Issued (Completed)": "resident_card_issued_section" } # ========================================================= # 2. INITIALIZE # ========================================================= current_stage = doc.get("current_stage") active_section = stage_sections.get(current_stage) all_sections_active = current_stage == "Onboarded" debug = [] debug.append("========== DYNAMIC VALIDATION STARTED ==========") debug.append("Document: " + str(doc.name)) debug.append("Current Stage: " + str(current_stage)) debug.append("Active Section: " + str(active_section)) debug.append("Onboarded: " + str(all_sections_active)) # ========================================================= # 3. BYPASS DEFAULT FRAMEWORK MANDATORY VALIDATION # ========================================================= doc.flags.ignore_mandatory = True debug.append("Framework Mandatory Check Bypassed") # ========================================================= # 4. IDENTIFY MANDATORY FIELDS DYNAMICALLY # ========================================================= current_section = None missing_fields = [] mandatory_fields_checked = [] stage_section_values = list(stage_sections.values()) for df in doc.meta.fields: # ----------------------------------------------------- # Identify current section # ----------------------------------------------------- if df.fieldtype == "Section Break": current_section = df.fieldname continue # ----------------------------------------------------- # Only process mandatory fields # ----------------------------------------------------- if not df.reqd: continue fieldname = df.fieldname field_label = df.label or fieldname # ----------------------------------------------------- # Determine whether field belongs to a stage section # ----------------------------------------------------- if current_section in stage_section_values: section_active = ( all_sections_active or current_section == active_section ) else: # Fields outside mapped stage sections # remain mandatory at every stage section_active = True debug.append( "FIELD: " + str(fieldname) + " | LABEL: " + str(field_label) + " | SECTION: " + str(current_section) + " | REQUIRED: " + str(df.reqd) + " | ACTIVE: " + str(section_active) ) # ----------------------------------------------------- # Skip mandatory fields belonging to hidden sections # ----------------------------------------------------- if not section_active: continue mandatory_fields_checked.append(fieldname) # ----------------------------------------------------- # Check missing values # ----------------------------------------------------- value = doc.get(fieldname) is_missing = False if value is None or value == "": is_missing = True elif df.fieldtype in ("Table", "Table MultiSelect"): if not value: is_missing = True # ----------------------------------------------------- # Add missing field # ----------------------------------------------------- if is_missing: missing_fields.append(field_label) # ========================================================= # 5. REMOVE DUPLICATE LABELS # ========================================================= unique_missing_fields = [] for field_label in missing_fields: if field_label not in unique_missing_fields: unique_missing_fields.append(field_label) # ========================================================= # 6. DEBUG LOG # ========================================================= debug.append( "Mandatory Fields Checked: " + str(mandatory_fields_checked) ) debug.append( "Missing Mandatory Fields: " + str(unique_missing_fields) ) if unique_missing_fields: debug.append("RESULT: VALIDATION FAILED") else: debug.append("RESULT: VALIDATION PASSED") debug.append("========== DYNAMIC VALIDATION COMPLETED ==========") frappe.log_error( "\n".join(debug), "Visa and PRO - Dynamic Mandatory Validation" ) # ========================================================= # 7. THROW VALIDATION ERROR # ========================================================= if unique_missing_fields: error_message = ( "Please fill the following mandatory fields " "before saving:

" ) for field_label in unique_missing_fields: error_message += "• " + field_label + "
" frappe.throw(error_message)
